probe.text_sample: Studio OL About About Contact I. Studio I. II. Photography II. III. Editorial III. IV. Interior IV. Olivia Lopez is the founder of Studio OL — a creative practice operating at the intersection of culture, design, and storytelling. With over a decade of experience in editorial working across media, hospitality and fashion, she develops environments that translate between physical and digital realms. Los Angeles @studio____ol @oliviavlopez Photograph by Justin Chung STUDIO OL operates at the intersection of cultural strategy, interior styling, and storytelling. Founded by Olivia Lopez, the studio’s practice is shaped by a background in editorial writing, visual production, and curation. One of the original voices in digital fashion¹, Lopez began her career at the forefront of independent publishing—building platforms that grew international audiences across fashion, media, and culture. ¹ The New Style Influencers Are Digital. In 2013, Lopez was featured in a front page story and broadcast segment on The Wall Street Journal on the emergence of fashion blogging and online publishing.
